frameLayout: time, hand qpos, wrist position(3), object position(3), object quaternion wxyz(4), phase, wrist quaternion wxyz(4), grasp optimization loss, arm qpos(7)

provenance.execution: Offline MuJoCo contact replay. Gravity-driven free object; native finger actuators, dynamic wrist target, no object attachment or pose commands after reset. Arm follows by native IK with table clearance.
provenance.grasp_selection: Object-specific forward approach, wrist roll, contact region, pregrasp, finger closure and timing. Cup uses handle-only contact and bounded measured-object wrist compensation during closure. All pairs were physically replayed and checked.
provenance.geometry: Cup handle faces sideways for finger entry; cup and dumbbell proportions were adjusted for native hand clearance. Allegro duck uses scale 1.2, Shadow bottle is shorter and wider.
provenance.loss: Sampled hand/object surface distance plus penetration, evaluated along physical execution.
provenance.scope: Illustrative static-site contact demonstration. No new GPT API calls, RL training, live neural inference, or hardware validation.
